messages:
tessa-pm: Quick sync — we have a new open model candidate (aurora-3b-open) from the intake queue. Need owners, perf + lic checks, and a staging canary slot. Can owners please ack and list blockers?

devin-ml: acked. I can take perf profiling. main ask: get a representative prompt set and the model weights URL.

maria-engineer: I can run perf tests once devin shares the prompt set. FYI I did a quick local quant test (INT8) — seq=128 cpu->gpu offload okay but 50% token throughput drop vs FP16. Will post numbers.

jonah-legal: ping — license looks like CC BY-NC-SA in the repo header. That’s a non-commercial clause, we need to confirm redistribution/hosting terms before adding to catalog. Can someone attach the upstream license file and a link to model provenance?

alex-ops: We have a free canary slot in eu-west-1 next Tue morning (9–11 UTC). Kernel update (cuda 12.3) scheduled Mon — if that lands we should repro on updated infra. Otherwise we'll use fallback gpu image.

devin-ml: copying checklist: 1) model weights URL, 2) license file, 3) eval prompts (n=100), 4) perf run script + target SLOs. I can run 1–3 once provided.

maria-engineer: partial perf snapshot (local, FP16):
```
tokens/sec: 1100
latency/p50: 45ms
latency/p95: 120ms
memory/gpu: 12.3GB
```
If we do static KV caching for prefix-heavy workloads p50 drops to ~30ms.

jonah-legal: Thanks — attaching license would help but initial read suggests CC BY-NC-SA prohibits commercial hosting. That likely blocks adding to Redwood hosted catalog. If customer wants private deployment (Private/VPC) that's OK. Need owner to confirm intended distribution model.

tessa-pm: Decision needed: do we want to pursue catalog inclusion (hosted) or only surface as Private? Can the model owners investigate relicensing options upstream? Timeline: want gating decision by EOD Fri so launch planning isn't blocked.

alex-ops: Ops note — if we only do Private, we can provision on-prem package next week; hosted onboarding requires legal sign-off and model provenance audit which adds ~2 weeks.

devin-ml: technical note — if licensing blocks hosted, we can still add perf profile to internal catalog for Dedicated scheduling decisions. That lets customers on Dedicated use the model without public hosting.

maria-engineer: I'll finish perf matrix by Thu morning and include INT8/FP16/4-bit numbers + sample prompts. Pls share the upstream URL and license file here so jonah can review.

jonah-legal: +1. If license stays NC, I'll draft suggested outreach language to request a relicense or explicit commercial permission. Will post draft here.

infra-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary slot reserved (eu-west-1) for aurora-3b-open on 1931310000 (Tue 09:00 UTC). Link: https://infra.internal/runs/aurora-3b/ci-1223 :robot_face: 

tessa-pm: great — owners: @devin-ml (perf), @maria-engineer (benchmarking), @jonah-legal (licensing), @alex-ops (canary infra). If anyone can't make those by EOD Fri call it out now. Otherwise I'll mark owners and follow up in launch board. :white_check_mark:
